sections.name: File setup, zip
sections.title: Set name, download and failure handling
sections.what: Checks the set name, builds the address, chooses the folder name, downloads the archive, and stops with a message if the download fails.
sections.why: Checking the name blocks unsafe folder names.
sections.watch_out: The rename to ipl_json applies only to the default set.

sections.name: sha256
sections.title: Fingerprint and unpack
sections.what: Fingerprints the archive, unzips it, skips names with slashes or double dots, writes the files, and writes a fetch record.
sections.why: Skipping those names stops files escaping the folder.
sections.watch_out: Subfolders inside the archive are silently skipped, so any nested data is lost.

summary: Downloads the Cricsheet archive of cricket match data and unpacks it into the raw data folder.
purpose: Fetches the raw Indian Premier League data the rest of the pipeline needs.
why: The file header says Cricsheet data is free under its terms, and tests use fixtures, so this script is never run in tests.
how: Checks the set name, downloads the zip, fingerprints it, unpacks the top-level files, and writes a fetch record with the address, time, size, fingerprint and file count.
inputs: An optional set name on the command line.
outputs: JSON match files in the raw folder, and a fetch record.
risks: A failed download prints a message and exits with an error. Unpacking overwrites existing files without checking.
debug: If it fails, the message gives the status; check network access to cricsheet.org.
